# Doxycycline for Post-Exposure Prophylaxis (doxy PEP)

# Indications:

Men who have sex with men (MSM) and transgender women (TGW) with 1 or more bacterial STI in the past 12 months OR MSM and TGW with multiple or anonymous sex partners.

# Lab orders (see recommendations below):

Lab: Syphilis antibody Serum

Lab: Chlamydia with Gonorrhea Urine
*Call lab x6025 for APTIMA Unisex Swab Specimen Collection Kit

Lab: Throat  swab for Chlamydia with Gonorrhea (submit only ONE swab in media)

Lab: Rectal  swab for Chlamydia with Gonorrhea (submit only ONE swab in media)

Lab: Vaginal swab for Chlamydia with Gonorrhea (submit only ONE swab in media)

Lab: HIV Ag/Ab

# **Please consider referral for HIV PrEP in all patients started on DoxyPEP**

< SELECT HERE> IFC Consult Minneapolis Infectious Diseases

References:
Bachmann LH, et al. MMWR Recommendations and Reports (2024) vol 73(2):1-8
Therapy:
## Screening recommendations for DoxyPEP (obtain at baseline and q3 months):

- Gonorrhea and chlamydia at all anatomic sites of exposure condomless sex. Can be taken daily depending on sexual activity, but no more than 200mg q 24 hours.

(urogenital, pharyngeal, and/or rectal)

- Syphilis antibody
- HIV Ag/Ab

# Order DoxyPEP #30 doses for 30 days with 2 refills:

Doxycycline 200mg PO PRN taken within 24hours but no later than 72hours after
